headline: How OpenAI Started in a Living Room

sentences.text: OpenAI started in a small living room in 2015.
Greg Brockman worked from his own home with friends.
The group created a smart computer program named GPT-2.
It wrote sentences like a real human person.
The creators feared it was too good to release.

grammar.title: Simile with Preposition Like
grammar.note: The word 'like' is used as a preposition to compare two things. Here, it compares how the program wrote text to how a person writes.

grammar.title: Too ... To Infinitive Pattern
grammar.note: This structure means something has so much of a quality that a certain action cannot or should not happen. It explains that the program was so good that creators decided not to release it.

sentences.text: A famous technology group started in a plain living room in 2015.
Greg Brockman and his team worked hard because they loved big ideas.
They built a smart language system called GPT-2 four years later.
The system wrote text so well that it surprised the whole team.
They worried about bad uses, so they did not release it fully.
Future researchers will learn from this unusual and cautious early decision.

grammar.title: Causative Subordinating Conjunction
grammar.note: The conjunction 'because' introduces a clause that gives the reason for an action. In this sentence, it explains why the team worked so hard.

grammar.title: So ... That Result Clause
grammar.note: This pattern shows a cause-and-effect relationship. 'So well' describes the degree of performance, and 'that' leads into the surprising result.

sentences.text: Long before OpenAI became famous, the group began inside a simple home living room.
Co-founder Greg Brockman hosted the early team, which focused on non-profit technology research.
In 2019, the organization created GPT-2, a language model that generates humanlike text.
The software performed so effectively that it shocked the researchers who created it.
They feared the program was too powerful, so they delayed its full public release.
Since that cautious moment, the company has transformed into a global technology giant.
Today, millions of people have used tools that grew from those humble beginnings.

grammar.focus: which focused on non-profit technology research
grammar.title: Non-defining Relative Clause
grammar.note: A non-defining relative clause starts with 'which' after a comma to give extra details about a noun. Here, it adds background information about the early team.

grammar.title: Present Perfect Tense
grammar.note: The present perfect (has + past participle) links a past event or change to the present time. It emphasizes that the past change affects the company's current status.

sentences.text: When OpenAI was founded in December 2015, its original team operated entirely out of a private living room.
Co-founder Greg Brockman provided the workspace while the non-profit research lab recruited its very first computer scientists.
The group was established to ensure that artificial intelligence would safely benefit all of humanity rather than private interests.
By 2019, the researchers had developed GPT-2, a large language model designed to process and generate natural text.
However, the system produced writing that was considered almost too convincing for immediate and unrestricted public distribution.
Company leaders reported that releasing the full model right away posed significant risks regarding potential automated misuse.
Consequently, a phased launch strategy was adopted to allow safety evaluation before releasing the complete software package.
That early hesitation sparked widespread debate about responsible innovation before the firm eventually became an industry leader.

grammar.title: Passive Voice in Time Clause
grammar.note: Passive voice (was + past participle) places focus on the organization receiving the action rather than who founded it. It sets the timeframe for the rest of the sentence.

grammar.title: Past Perfect Tense
grammar.note: The past perfect (had + past participle) indicates that an action was completed before another point in the past ('By 2019'). It clearly establishes chronological sequence.

grammar.focus: releasing the full model right away
grammar.title: Gerund Phrase as Subject
grammar.note: An -ing verb phrase can act as a noun subject within a subordinate clause. Here, the action of releasing the model serves as the subject of the verb 'posed'.

sentences.text: Before OpenAI became a multi-billion-dollar juggernaut dominating headlines, it operated as a modest non-profit initiative out of a residential living room.
Co-founder Greg Brockman hosted the initial cohort of scientists in December 2015, united by a shared mission to develop safe artificial intelligence.
Operating on a fraction of tech giants' funding, the lean team set out to challenge established industry rivals through open research collaboration.
That idealistic approach faced its first major test in 2019 with the creation of GPT-2, an advanced language model capable of generating coherent text.
To the team's surprise, the software generated prose so persuasively human that executives hesitated to release the complete software code immediately.
Fearing potential misuse in automated misinformation campaigns, OpenAI made the unprecedented decision to withhold the full model during its initial announcement.
The move ignited intense discussion across the tech sector, with critics questioning whether the danger was genuine or clever marketing.
Looking back, that theatrical moment of caution marked a pivotal transition from informal startup culture to high-stakes global technology pioneer.

grammar.focus: Operating on a fraction of tech giants' funding
grammar.title: Fronted Participle Clause
grammar.note: A present participle phrase placed at the beginning of a sentence modifies the subject that follows. It provides background context about the conditions under which the team worked.

grammar.focus: Fearing potential misuse in automated misinformation campaigns
grammar.title: Participial Phrase of Reason
grammar.note: An -ing participial phrase at the start of a sentence can function like an adverbial clause showing cause. It explains why OpenAI decided to withhold the model.

grammar.focus: with critics questioning whether the danger was genuine or clever marketing
grammar.title: With Absolute Construction
grammar.note: The preposition 'with' followed by a noun ('critics') and a participle ('questioning') introduces accompanying circumstance. It describes an action happening alongside the main event.
